header: Amazon OpenSearch Service ML connectors for AWS services
content:
When you use Amazon OpenSearch Service machine learning (ML) connectors with another
AWS service, you need to set up an IAM role to securely connect OpenSearch Service to that
service. AWS services that you can set up a connector to include Amazon SageMaker AI and
Amazon Bedrock. In this tutorial, we cover how to create a connector from OpenSearch Service to
SageMaker Runtime. For more information about connectors, see Supported connectors.
